title: learning-mode-selection
description: The result of the mode selector of learning (feature 106; a record not of annex B §B.20, so it stays internal, $id in the internal form of row 32 of 'What the other features must follow'). It is the value the resolution of F106-FR-009 returns and the doctor reports, and what the binding block `configuration.learning` of the launch contract pins against.

mode.description: The closed set of F106-FR-009 (closed set 77), the default `off`; a value that is not a member reads as `off`

through.description: The run id the decision log is bound through (F106-FR-027), or null for no bound

mode_source.description: Where the mode was read from; the launch contract's pin wins over the as-is alias SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING

through_source.description: Where the bound was read from (the alias SPECSTRIDE_LEARNING_THROUGH)

observes.description: Whether the layer watches the runs under this mode

takes_effect.description: Whether a learned value takes effect at run time under this mode

evaluates.description: Whether the layer evaluates applied decisions and may revert one automatically
